dialect.detail: Likely a PC/DOS-era COBOL compiler (possibly Micro Focus or ACU) given Windows path 'C:\PROVS\prov.dat', VALUE OF FILE-ID clause, ASSIGN TO DISK, and LINKAGE SECTION subprogram pattern. Spanish-language identifiers suggest Latin American origin.
evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with PROCEDURE DIVISION USING
USE AFTER ERROR PROCEDURE ON I-O (DECLARATIVES)

purpose.domain_detail: Supplier/provider master file maintenance — updates supplier records in an indexed file
purpose.summary: This is a subprogram (ACTUALIZAR-PROV) that manages an indexed supplier file. It accepts a parameter to open, close, or update a supplier record, incrementing a consultation counter and returning the supplier's category and description to the caller.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with PROCEDURE DIVISION USING (called subprogram)
DECLARATIVES with USE AFTER ERROR on all file operations
VALUE OF FILE-ID clause for hardcoded Windows file path
ASSIGN TO DISK with INDEXED organization
verdict.notes: No COPY statements or SQL. The hardcoded Windows path and ASSIGN TO DISK suggest a PC COBOL environment (possibly Micro Focus Personal COBOL or similar). The tab-indented lines in the record/working-storage area are mixed with space-indented lines but all lines are within 72 columns so fixed format is confirmed. No comment lines present.
